input.summary: Add 30 days' prior written notice and business-hours limitation to Harpoon's audit right in Section 6.11
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.11 caps audit frequency and puts cost on Harpoon, but permits an audit on request with no advance notice; we added thirty (30) days' prior written notice and a normal-business-hours limitation so audits do not disrupt operations. We can accept fifteen (15) days' notice if Harpoon prefers.

ops.oldText: At the request of Harpoon, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm
ops.newText: At the request of Harpoon, upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to AbbVie and during AbbVie's normal business hours, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm
